name: HubSpot Private App
description: HubSpot Private App is a single-account integration that authenticates API requests with a static access token scoped to selected HubSpot resources.
agentUseSummary: This single-account credential pattern is visible as a canonical HubSpot extension preview. Relay will not collect a private-app token or create duplicate CRM tools beside the canonical HubSpot OAuth connector.

capabilities.label: Use a single-account HubSpot private app
capabilities.description: If customer-managed static auth is approved, extend the canonical HubSpot connector with an immutable hub, app, token, scope and rotation binding.

blocked.label: Create duplicate HubSpot provider state
blocked.description: A private-app listing must not create a parallel token, tool or approval surface beside Relay's canonical HubSpot OAuth connector.

blocked.label: Capture a HubSpot private-app token
blocked.description: Relay will not ask an account administrator to reveal or paste a static private-app access token into this Marketplace alias.

blocked.label: Create or administer a HubSpot private app
blocked.description: Creating, installing, revealing, rotating, reinstalling or deleting a private app is account administration outside Relay agent actions.

blocked.label: Expand private-app scopes
blocked.description: Relay will not add write, sensitive-data or broader CRM scopes to a customer-managed static token.

blocked.label: Run HubSpot actions from the setup alias
blocked.description: This alias exposes no runtime actions; approved static auth must reuse the canonical connector's exact hub binding, typed reads, approvals and audits.

approvalProfiles.label: HubSpot private-app security review
approvalProfiles.description: This setup alias is not connectable. Static tokens remain unavailable unless the canonical HubSpot connector has a least-privilege, revocable customer-managed identity design.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; static auth must extend the canonical HubSpot provider pack.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; static auth must extend the canonical HubSpot provider pack.

providerSetup.blocker: HubSpot private apps use a static access token for one account. The token is a customer-controlled bearer secret and its scopes can reach CRM or sensitive data. Relay already supports multi-account OAuth through the canonical HubSpot connector and does not accept customer private-app tokens.
providerSetup.nextAction: Prefer Relay-owned OAuth on the canonical HubSpot connector. For an approved static-auth case, extend that connector with immutable hub/app/token binding, only the existing Company and Deal read scopes, administrator ownership, encrypted storage, six-month-or-better rotation, deactivation and the existing typed action policies.

evidence.supports: HubSpot states OAuth is required for multi-account distribution while static access tokens are for a single authorized account.

HubSpot documents super-admin or developer-seat control of static tokens, recommends rotation every six months, requires reinstall after scope changes and limits a static-auth install to one account at a time.
HubSpot scopes grant access to specific API endpoints and account data and distinguish required, conditional and optional permissions.

HubSpot identifies OAuth and private access tokens as API authentication methods, requires OAuth for multi-customer integrations, and automatically deactivates private tokens detected in public GitHub content.
